role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 近斗使人无可奈何，远战又招招致命，魅惑魔女只要出手就能刺穿敌人，她的攻击融入了魔力后敌人逃得越远，所受伤害也越高。不论是在敌人身上施加强大的减速效果，还是魅惑丛林中的生物来助战，她总是不乏制胜的手段。
hero_summary_en: Harmful up close and lethal at a distance, Enchantress skewers foes with attacks imbued to become more damaging the further they fly. Whether inflicting powerful slows on her enemies or charming forest creatures to fight her battles, she is never short of tools to win a fight.

abilities.name: enchantress_impetus
abilities.description_zh: 激活后每次攻击都有附魔效果，根据与目标的距离造成额外伤害。目标越远，伤害越高。对幻象造成双倍伤害。
abilities.description_en: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
notes_zh: 造成伤害上限的距离是%distance_cap%。
计算与目标之间的距离在攻击弹道击中目标时。
notes_en: The damage is capped at %distance_cap% distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.

abilities.name: enchantress_enchant
abilities.description_zh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

scepter_loc.en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。

facet_text_en: Cast Range of Enchant is increased. If the enemy is a hero, Enchantress and units she controls have increased attack range against the target.
facet_text_zh: 魅惑的施法距离增加。如果目标是英雄，魅惑魔女和她控制的单位对目标的攻击距离增加。

abilities.name: enchantress_natures_attendants
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一群小精灵治疗魅惑魔女以及身边的友方单位。
abilities.description_en: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
notes_zh: 不会选择满血单位进行治疗。
notes_en: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.
facet_text_en: Whenever Enchantress takes more than %overprotective_damage_threshold% damage from enemy heroes, %overprotective_wisp_count% wisp appears for %overprotective_wisp_duration%s to heal her. A maximum of %overprotective_max_wisps% overprotective wisps can exist at the same time.
facet_text_zh: 只要魅惑魔女受到敌方英雄的伤害超过%overprotective_damage_threshold%点，%overprotective_wisp_count%个小精灵就会出现，%overprotective_wisp_duration%秒内进行治疗。同一时间最多只能存在%overprotective_max_wisps%个过度保护的小精灵。

abilities.name: enchantress_bunny_hop
abilities.description_zh: 向后跳跃，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，并向魅惑魔女的攻击距离+%bonus_attack_range%范围内最远的%attack_targets%个敌方单位发动一次附有推进的攻击。
abilities.description_en: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the %attack_targets% furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + %bonus_attack_range%.

abilities.name: enchantress_little_friends
abilities.description_zh: 魅惑魔女缠绕一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: enchantress_untouchable
abilities.description_zh: 魅惑魔女让她的敌人神魂颠倒，受到他们攻击时会降低其攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
notes_zh: 所有直接攻击魅惑魔女的敌方单位都会被减速。
减速效果在攻击单位产生攻击动作时出现，而不是伤害生效时。
notes_en: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.

abilities.name: enchantress_rabblerouser
abilities.description_zh: 魅惑魔女使所有中立生物和魅惑魔女控制下的单位对敌方英雄造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
notes_zh: 不会影响劝化的中立生物、痛苦魔方和肉山。
notes_en: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.
